releaseNotes:
- SSH Git remotes no longer fail setup just because Windows ssh-agent is empty
- Git uses a real ssh.exe and on-disk keys (like CMD), not only ssh-add
- New SSH key helper: browse, generate ed25519, copy the public key, and Test
- Settings Git has SSH key path with Browse, Test, and the same helper
- HTTPS remotes skip the SSH modal; rejected keys show a clear GitHub/GitLab message
